retailer_description"One step. Three acids. Results that build. Andalou's Resurfacing Triple Acid Exfoliating Toner is a milky, leave-on 5% AHA toner that addresses texture, pore appearance, and the look of dark spots all at once — because your skin deserves more than a single-acid solution. Powered by Fruit Science™, glycolic, lactic, and mandelic acids each do a different job: glycolic exfoliates at the surface, lactic smooths and supports hydration, mandelic gently addresses uneven tone. Niacinamide visibly refines pore appearance while pineapple and papaya enzymes lift dull surface buildup. The result is skin that looks smoother, more even-toned, and visibly refreshed — no rinsing required. Rooted in renewal and refined by science — at Andalou, our patented Fruit Science™ innovation is clinically proven to support skin's natural wisdom. We don't fight change. We formulate for it. Suitable for sensitive skin. Dermatologist tested. Begin 1–2 uses weekly, increasing to daily as tolerated. Sunburn Alert: This product contains alpha hydroxy acids (AHAs). Apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen daily while using this product and for one week after. AHAs may increase skin's sensitivity to sun exposure. Formulated without parabens, sulfates, phthalates, or other harmful additives. Cruelty free."

retailer_description"Honey Nut Cheerios Cereal is un-bee-lievably delicious! Every box of this gluten free, sweetened, whole grain oat cereal brings the taste of real honey and natural almond flavor to your family table. Honey Nut Cheerios can help lower cholesterol* as part of a heart healthy diet. *Three grams of soluble fiber daily from whole grain oat foods, like Honey Nut Cheerios Cereal, in a diet low in saturated fat and cholesterol, may reduce the risk of heart disease. Honey Nut Cheerios Cereal provides .75g per serving. Each serving of Honey Nut Cheerios provides 22g of whole grain (at least 48g recommended daily), 12 vitamins and minerals, and a good source of both calcium and fiber. Beyond a quick part of breakfast for adults or kids, these yummy whole grain cereal Os made with oats, make an easy, gluten free snack by the handful. Pack some crispy cereal in a lunch box for a sweet treat. Or use these honey cereal Os as an ingredient in your favorite cereal bars recipe. However you enjoy Honey Nut Cheerios, it's a part of General Mills breakfast cereals, spreading goodness from tots to grown-ups. Contains one cardboard box of crunchy Honey Nut Cheerios, Heart Healthy Gluten Free Breakfast Cereal, 10.8 oz; Perfect for instant snacking, or a part of breakfast and meals."

retailer_description"Navitas Organics Pomegranate Powder is a unique and versatile way to enjoy the delicious taste and antioxidant benefits of pomegranate year-round. A perfectly sweet-tart powder, Navitas Organics Pomegranate Powder is made from carefully removing and juicing the nutrient-rich seeds from the ripened organic pomegranate fruit. Treasured since ancient times, the pomegranate is particularly revered for containing the unique antioxidant ellagic acid, which helps support cellular health and longevity. Navitas Organics Pomegranate Powder has a bright, sweet taste that is fantastic in smoothies, yogurt, oatmeal, marinades, desserts, salad dressings and baked goods. retailer_description"Bring a unique red wine to your table with 14 Hands Cabernet Sauvignon. A medium bodied, red wine with notes of black currants and juicy dark cherry is emboldened by a tantalizing undercurrent of spicy oak. Refined tannins emphasize the fruit-forward taste of the dry wine. Made in Washington state’s renowned Columbia Valley, this dry red wine is anything but boring. This delicious Cabernet Sauvignon wine pairs beautifully with appetizers, lamb, beef or red sauce pasta dishes. Add an adventurous flair to drinks with friends or to a quiet dinner when you pour a glass from this 14 Hands bottle of wine. Serve this red wine at room temperature and unleash the bold flavors within. Wine bottles are 750 ml and have a 13.5% ABV. 14 Hands is inspired by the unbridled spirit of the wild horses that once freely roamed eastern Washington. Like the untamed horses we honor with our name, our wild and wonderful wines pack a lot of character into each bottle."

retailer_description"Bring a unique, polished red wine to your table with 14 Hands Hot to Trot Smooth Red Blend. This dauntless red wine blend tempts right off the bat with aromas of bright cherry and succulent red currant. A medium bodied, slightly dry red wine with notes of berry and plum and a spicy finish is the perfect beginning to an unforgettable night. Flavors of cherry pie, ripe berries and plums give way to subtle notes of baking spice on a persistent finish. Hot to Trot Red Blend consists predominantly of Cabernet Sauvignon and Merlot and other varietals including Syrah, Cabernet Franc and Petit Verdot, making it a deliciously complex bottle of wine. Made in Washington state’s renowned Columbia Valley, this red blend wine brings the spirit of the wild in each drop. This delicious red wine pairs beautifully with pork chops, grilled portabella mushrooms, gourmet cheeses and pasta dishes. Wine bottles are 750 ml and have a 13.5% ABV. Our wild and wonderful wines pack a lot of character into each bottle."

retailer_description"\"At ALOHA, we believe that plants are the ultimate source of nourishment, and that real foods should be really convenient. So when you're looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we've got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of cane sugar, ALOHA's protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day with no artificial ingredients or sugar alcohols. ALOHA's organic, plant-based products are vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free (lactose-free), stevia-free, high protein, Kosher Certified and USDA certified organic. ALOHA checks all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA Protein Bars are corn-free — our organic vegetable glycerin is derived from flax seed, not corn. ALOHA's organic, plant-based Chocolate Fudge Brownie protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic cocoa powder. The perfect protein bar for when you're between meetings, warming up for the gym (or cooling down!), on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar.\""
retailer_ingredients"Peanuts*, Tapioca Fiber*, Protein Blend* (Brown Rice Protein*, Pumpkin Seed Protein*), Chocolate Chips* (Chocolate*, Cane Sugar*, Cocoa Butter*, Vanilla Extract*), Tapioca Syrup*, Vegetable Glycerin*, Roasted Pumpkin Seeds*, Sea Salt, Monk Fruit*. *Organic. Contains: Peanuts. Manufactured in a facility that also processes fish, milk, sesame, soy, tree nuts, and wheat."

retailer_description"At ALOHA, we believe that plants are the ultimate source of nourishment, and that real foods should be really convenient. So when you’re looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we’ve got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of natural sugar, ALOHA’s protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day without the dreaded sugar crash. ALOHA’s organic, plant-based products are vegan, non-GMO, gluten-free, soy-free, dairy-free lactose-free, stevia-free, high protein, Kosher Certified and USDA certified organic. ALOHA checks the all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA’s organic, plant-based Chocolate Mint protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic peppermint oil. The perfect protein bar for when you’re between meetings, warming up for the gym or cooling down, on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar."

Carefully crafted with non-GMO ingredients, these snack bars are made with no high-fructose corn syrup, so you can feel good about sharing them with the whole family. Best of all, Annie's Chocolate Chip Chewy Bars feature 8g of whole grain per serving. And like all Annie's granola bars, they're made with goodness. That means no artificial flavors or synthetic colors. Annie's makes products in over 20 family-friendly categories, from fruit-flavored snacks and cereal to mac and cheese. For busy bunnies and families on the go, we help make life a little easier and more delicious by spreading goodness through tasty foods and kindness to the planet. 8g whole grain per serving. At least 48g recommended daily."

Athletic Brewing Company Craft Non-Alcoholic Beer

retailer_department"gl_grocery"
retailer_description"Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers provide the perfect alternative for those who want to enjoy the taste of craft beer without the hangover. Whether you’re craving a crisp IPA, a smooth golden, or a light, refreshing brew, we offer a wide range of styles to satisfy your taste buds. Made with the finest ingredients, our beers include malted barley, hops, yeast, water, and wheat, ensuring a well-balanced, flavorful brew. The secret behind our great taste lies in our careful brewing method, which allows us to craft each Non Alcoholic beer with the same passion and precision as traditional craft brews, while maintaining the same flavor. Perfect for those looking for a mindful alcohol alternative, our beers contain less than 0.5% alcohol by volume, making them suitable for any time of the day. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers are designed for active, health-conscious individuals who love the taste of brews but want to make mindful choices. Our Non Alcoholic beer selection includes classics like Run Wild IPA, Upside Dawn Golden, Athletic Lite, and Free Wave, with regular releases of unique styles and experimental brews that showcase our passion for innovation. Each brew is carefully crafted to provide the same depth of flavor you’d expect from a traditional craft beer, without the unwanted effects. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beer is your go-to drink. It’s a great fit for any lifestyle, whether you’re indulging in pizza, a salad, or grilling. Perfectly paired with a variety of meals, desserts, and activities, it’s a refreshing choice for anyone who wants to enjoy the taste of beer without the alcohol. With a variety of styles to choose from, including hazy IPAs and light and dark brews, there’s a flavor to suit every palate. From casual drinking to special occasions, Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers let you enjoy the best of both worlds: the refreshing taste of craft beer and the benefits of choosing a Non Alcoholic beverage."

retailer_product_type"SNACK_FOOD_BAR"
retailer_department"gl_grocery"
retailer_description"Meet TRUBAR Kids Protein Bars — the snack that finally checks every box. Designed with parents in mind and kids at heart, these soft, chewy bars deliver a balanced, school-friendly snack made with wholesome ingredients that taste as good as they feel. Each bar is gluten free, peanut free, and tree nut free, so you can toss them into lunchboxes, backpacks, or sports bags with total confidence. Every TRUBAR Kids bar is packed with 8–9 grams of plant-based protein from brown rice and organic pea protein, along with fiber to help keep kids feeling satisfied through school, sports, and play. Whether it’s a busy weekday morning or an after-school pick-me-up, these bars provide steady, delicious fuel, without excess sugar, artificial ingredients, or the crash of overly sweet snacks. Choose from three flavors kids love: Pop Goes Confetti, a soft and colorful vanilla cake–inspired bar that makes snack time feel like a celebration; Fudge-Tastic Brownie, a rich, chocolatey treat made with real cocoa powder; and Iced Oatmeal Blast, a cozy, cookie-like flavor that combines oats, vanilla, and cinnamon for a nostalgic twist. Or try them all in the convenient Variety Pack, perfect for keeping snack time fun and fresh all week long. Made with real, simple ingredients like tapioca fiber, sunflower seeds, gluten-free oats, and sustainably sourced palm oil, TRUBAR Kids bars are free from artificial flavors, fillers, and preservatives. They’re Non-GMO, allergy-friendly, and thoughtfully crafted with clean, wholesome ingredients you can trust. With low sugar (just 4–5 g per bar) and only 140 calories, these individually wrapped protein bars make it easy to snack smart anytime, anywhere. Perfect for school lunches, car rides, travel, or busy mornings, TRUBAR Kids Protein Bars are the ultimate grab-and-go snack for families who care about what goes into every bite."
retailer_ingredients"TAPIOCA BLEND (TAPIOCA FIBER, TAPIOCA SYRUP, CASSAVA ROOT FLOUR), PROTEIN BLEND (BROWN RICE PROTEIN, ORGANIC PEA PROTEIN), ALMONDS, ORGANIC CANE SUGAR, PALM OIL*, FAIRLY TRADED COCOA POWDER, SEA SALT, SUNFLOWER LECITHIN. CONTAINS: TREE NUTS (ALMONDS). *SUSTAINABLY SOURCED PALM OIL"

retailer_department"gl_grocery"
retailer_description"Meet TRUBAR Kids Protein Bars — the snack that finally checks every box. Designed with parents in mind and kids at heart, these soft, chewy bars deliver a balanced, school-friendly snack made with wholesome ingredients that taste as good as they feel. Each bar is gluten free, peanut free, and tree nut free, so you can toss them into lunchboxes, backpacks, or sports bags with total confidence. Every TRUBAR Kids bar is packed with 8–9 grams of plant-based protein from brown rice and organic pea protein, along with fiber to help keep kids feeling satisfied through school, sports, and play. Whether it’s a busy weekday morning or an after-school pick-me-up, these bars provide steady, delicious fuel, without excess sugar, artificial ingredients, or the crash of overly sweet snacks. Choose from three flavors kids love: Pop Goes Confetti, a soft and colorful vanilla cake–inspired bar that makes snack time feel like a celebration; Fudge-Tastic Brownie, a rich, chocolatey treat made with real cocoa powder; and Iced Oatmeal Blast, a cozy, cookie-like flavor that combines oats, vanilla, and cinnamon for a nostalgic twist. Or try them all in the convenient Variety Pack, perfect for keeping snack time fun and fresh all week long. Made with real, simple ingredients like tapioca fiber, sunflower seeds, gluten-free oats, and sustainably sourced palm oil, TRUBAR Kids bars are free from artificial flavors, fillers, and preservatives. They’re Non-GMO, allergy-friendly, and thoughtfully crafted with clean, wholesome ingredients you can trust. With low sugar (just 4–5 g per bar) and only 140 calories, these individually wrapped protein bars make it easy to snack smart anytime, anywhere. Perfect for school lunches, car rides, travel, or busy mornings, TRUBAR Kids Protein Bars are the ultimate grab-and-go snack for families who care about what goes into every bite."

retailer_description"Scattered Peaks is an elevated spin on Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon carefully curated and elegantly crafted by wine industry icon, Derek Benham and legendary Napa Valley Winemaker, Joel Aiken. Leveraging their deep passion for – and long history within – the California wine industry, Derek and Joel curate superior fruit from coveted regions throughout Napa Valley. Their plunder is then aged in carefully curated oak barrels and artfully blended to achieve the high levels of quality and experience. Scattered Peaks is a creative marriage of Derek’s greatest loves: surfing, skiing and wine. A powerful triple-entendre, the term ‘Scattered Peaks’ refers to a surfing condition when waves approaching the shore split, creating different wave peaks. Secondly, the term signifies the many snowy peaks around the world that Benham has conquered with unmatched enthusiasm. Finally, ‘Scattered Peaks’ refers to our vineyards dotted across the world-renowned Napa Valley."
